local_git.commit.description: A commit observed in a user-selected local Git repository.

provider.description: Upstream protocol that produced the record.

captureMethod.description: Git traversal used to discover the commit.

repo.description: Configured local repository identity and display metadata.

path.description: Local repository path with the home directory collapsed to '~'.

normalizedOriginUrl.description: Normalized origin URL when the repository has one.

objectFormat.description: Git object hash format used by the repository.

commitSha.description: Full Git object ID of the commit.

author.description: Author identity, subject to the configured email capture policy.

committer.description: Committer identity, subject to the configured email capture policy.

authoredByUser.description: Whether the author email matches a configured user identity.

committedByUser.description: Whether the committer email matches a configured user identity.

message.description: Commit-message capture result under the configured privacy mode.

diffstat.description: Diffstat capture result under the configured privacy mode.

codeDiff.description: Code-diff capture result, which may contain an inline summary or content reference.
